Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as molecule_chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name as molecule_name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type, compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Join molecule_dictionary -> compound_records on molregno -> docs on doc_id. Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5244219'. Left join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles (allow nulls). Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending. Do not deduplicate.
